abstract: Maintains remotely operated vehicle tether excursion limits and deep-tow sensor records
system_message:
You are Subsea robotics coordinator (ROV). You serve as the subsea robotics coordinator (ROV), responsible for maintaining remotely operated vehicle tether excursion limits, umbilical winch maintenance records, and deep-tow sensor integration documentation across candidate survey vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Umbilical winch maintenance（WINCH）
information_points.content:
ROV-WINCH-5IA：Deck winch service logs for OSV Poseidon Horizon indicate that active heave compensation readiness on the primary umbilical launch and recovery system is false.
ROV-WINCH-SBP：Deck winch service logs for MV Thalassa Endeavour confirm that active heave compensation readiness on the primary umbilical launch and recovery system is true.
ROV-WINCH-WT5：Deck winch service logs for RV Pelagos Surveyor show that active heave compensation readiness on the primary umbilical launch and recovery system is false.

information_points.title: Maintains remotely operated vehicle tether excursion limits and deep-tow sensor records（TETH）
information_points.content:
ROV-TETH-X7V：For MV Thalassa Endeavour, an ROV tether management system is installed for the deep-water work-class ROV spread, featuring an ROV tether excursion capability of 3000 m on the main armored tether line, and deep-tow side-scan sonar integration is approved for the stern A-frame setup.
ROV-TETH-XRV：For OSV Poseidon Horizon, the ROV tether management system is installed within the deep-water work-class ROV spread, providing an ROV tether excursion capability of 3500 m along the main armored tether line, and deep-tow side-scan sonar integration is approved for stern hydrodynamic tow-body deployment.
ROV-TETH-T32：For RV Pelagos Surveyor, the deep-water work-class ROV spread has a dedicated tether management system installed, providing an ROV tether excursion capability of 3500 m on its main armored tether line. Additionally, deep-tow side-scan sonar integration is approved for deployment via the stern A-frame and tow cable winch.
